**Investigating Conflicting Data**

I'm puzzled. I've encountered files that claim to be "daily" but aren't set to a viewMode. My hunch is that this could have been caused by some minification or renaming. I'm going to check previous versions of these files to investigate if the term "daily" existed in previous versions of the file.

args.CommandLine: "node -e \"const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const histPath = 'C:/Users/pedro/AppData/Roaming/Code/User/History'; if (!fs.existsSync(histPath)) { console.log('not exists'); process.exit(0); } function walk(dir) { let results = []; const list = fs.readdirSync(dir); list.forEach(file => { const fullPath = path.join(dir, file); const stat = fs.statSync(fullPath); if (stat.isDirectory()) { results = results.concat(walk(fullPath)); } else { results.push({ path: fullPath, mtime: stat.mtime }); } }); return results; } const files = walk(histPath); console.log('Total files:', files.length); const recent = files.filter(f => f.mtime > new Date('2026-06-01')); console.log('Recent files (since June 1, 2026):', recent.length); recent.sort((a, b) => b.mtime - a.mtime); recent.slice(0, 50).forEach(f => console.log(f.path, f.mtime, fs.statSync(f.path).size));\""
